item.description:
Symphonia 1.0.2 recovers more easily when macOS blocks its network access.

  • Tries again on its own. If Symphonia hears nothing from any other device on your network for 10 minutes, it now reconnects to the network by itself, and keeps trying every 5 minutes until players can find it again.
  • If you see the warning, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network on the Mac running Symphonia and turn Symphonia off and on again. After turning it off and on again, Symphonia may reconnect without a restart; if the warning is still there after 5 minutes, quit and reopen Symphonia.
